description: Toggle a built-in tool on or off for a specific bot. Enabled tools become available in the bot's conversations. Example tool IDs: delete_message, post_to_channel, post_status, web_search, send_direct_message, react_to_message, set_reminder, create_poll.

botId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the bot to toggle the tool for

enabled.description: Whether to enable (true) or disable (false) the tool

name: neuron_toggle_builtin_tool
title: Toggle Built-in Tool
